title: Representation of the People Eighth Amendment Act 1985

sections.shortTitle: Representation of the People Eighth Amendment Act 1985
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XI OF 1985
ACT XI OF 1985
REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE (EIGHTH AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985
An Act further to amend the Representation of the People Act, 1976
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th July, 1985]
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of
President on the 15th July, 1985, and is hereby published for information :-
1. Short title and commencement.-(1) This Act may be
called the Representation of the People (Eighth Amendment) Act, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: Representation of the People Eighth Amendment Act 1985
sections.description:
Amendment of section 50, Act LXXXV of 1976

ACT XI OF 1985
ACT XI OF 1985
REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE (EIGHTH AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985
An Act further to amend the Representation of the People Act, 1976
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th July, 1985]
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of
President on the 15th July, 1985, and is hereby published for information :-
2. Amendment of section 50, Act LXXXV of 1976.---In the Representa tion of the People Act,
1976 (LXXXV of 1976), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 50,
after subsection (2), the following new subsection shall be added, namely
"(3) Notwithstanding anything contained in subsection (1), a con testing
candidate at the elections held under the Houses of Parliament and Provincial
Assemblies (Elections) Order, 1977, shall not be required to submit a return of
election expenses.".

sections.shortTitle: Representation of the People Eighth Amendment Act 1985
sections.description:
Amendment of section 99, Act LXXXV of 1976

ACT XI OF 1985
ACT XI OF 1985
REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE (EIGHTH AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985
An Act further to amend the Representation of the People Act, 1976
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th July, 1985]
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of
President on the 15th July, 1985, and is hereby published for information :-
3. Amendment of section 99, Act LXXXV of 1976.-----In the said Act, in section 99, in subsection
(1), after clause (e), the following new clause shall be inserted, namely :-
"(ee) he, being a person elected to the National Assembly or a
Provincial Assembly, is found by the Commission to have subscribed, after the
commencement of the Representation of the People (Eighth Amendment) Ordinance,
1985, either as proposer or seconder, in contravention of the provisions of
this Act or the rules made thereunder, to the nomination of more than one
candidate for a seat or seats ; or".
